prompt: Close-up of a hulking stone gargoyle statue awakening, its weathered grey granite face and shoulders filling the frame in a low three-quarter view. Deep glowing blue cracks split across the stone like Lichtenberg figures and its eyes ignite with cerulean light as it stirs from dormancy. Moss and lichen flake from its cracking surface. The only source of light is the blue glow pouring out from inside the cracks. The background is a dim ruined stone courtyard at dusk.

A massive moss-slicked stone golem rising from a dormant kneeling crouch in a ruined overgrown courtyard, side profile facing east, one heavy granite arm pushing off the ground as it stands. Glowing blue runes flare to life across its body and seams of cerulean light open along its joints as it awakens. The only source of light is the blue rune-glow. The background is crumbling ivy-covered stone pillars under a dim twilight sky.

A wizard in deep sapphire blue robes stands at left, side profile, both hands thrust forward channeling a stream of crackling cerulean energy into a tall grey stone statue at right. The statue is cracking alive, blue light bursting from the fractures, its stone eyes lighting up as it animates. Two figures, both fully visible. The only source of light is the blue magic arcing between the mage and the statue. The background is a torchlit ancient temple hall.

A stone gargoyle springing off a castle parapet into flight, wings cracking free of solid rock and spreading wide, body lunging forward toward the viewer. Glowing cerulean light charges along the leading edges of its stone wings and its eyes blaze blue as it surges back into motion. Chips of grey granite scatter behind it. The background is a moonlit night sky over distant battlements.

A towering grey granite stone golem mid-awakening in a ruined courtyard, standing tall and stretching, head tilting up as glowing cerulean seams of light crack open across its chest, shoulders and arms. Its carved eyes blaze bright blue. The stone is bare weathered grey rock, only a little moss. The only source of light is the blue energy glowing from the cracks in its body. The background is crumbling stone pillars under a deep blue twilight sky.

A wizard in cerulean blue robes at left in side profile, one hand raised, casting glowing blue magic onto a kneeling grey stone statue of a warrior at right. The statue is jolting awake, cracks of brilliant blue light splitting across its stone body, its head snapping up and eyes flaring blue as it animates and starts to rise. Both figures fully visible, same size. The only light is the blue magic. The background is a dim mossy temple ruin.

Low worms-eye view of a colossal grey stone guardian statue looming overhead as it awakens, looking down at the viewer, one huge granite fist clenching. Brilliant cerulean cracks of light spider across its torso and its eyes ignite a blinding blue. Dust and stone chips fall toward the camera. The only source of light is the blue glow from within its cracking stone body. The background is a dark vaulted ancient hall.

Close-up three-quarter view of a carved grey stone statue head and shoulders snapping to life, mouth opening and carved eyes flooding with bright cerulean light from within, a glowing blue crack splitting down its cheek and across its collar. Bare weathered granite with flecks of lichen. The only source of light is the blue glow from its eyes and cracks. The background is a shadowy ruined shrine with a faint blue haze.
